citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.9 (combination code: assign only the combination code when it fully identifies the conditions documented; multiple coding is not used when a combination code identifies all the elements); Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms associated routinely with a disease process are not assigned as additional codes); Section IV.G (list first the diagnosis chiefly responsible for the services provided)

coder_notes: The provider documents one diagnosis, hypertrophy of tonsils with hypertrophy of adenoids, and one code names both. The separate codes for hypertrophy of tonsils (J35.1) and hypertrophy of adenoids (J35.2) are not reported in its place. Mouth breathing and snoring are symptoms of the condition and are not coded. There is no tonsillitis or adenoiditis, and no sleep apnea is diagnosed. Traps: reporting J35.1 and J35.2 as two codes; adding snoring or mouth breathing codes; a tonsillitis code; a sleep apnea code from the snoring and the airway obstruction
